# dsh-cmdgo-provider attribution

Parts of `src/commandcode/` are derived from:

- Project: `dsh-cmdgo-provider`
- Upstream: https://github.com/Ajwyunsx/dsh-cmdgo-provider
- Revision reviewed: `6b74ff58b7ba530a43979166d3fddf0a7afb2be8` (0.9.1)
- Upstream license: MIT
- Copyright: Copyright (c) 2026 Ajwyunsx

The copied concepts and code were adapted from the DSH plugin/runtime model to
ai-proxy's Deno/edge provider architecture. Changes include OpenAI Chat
Completions and Responses translation, local JSON account persistence, Deno
OAuth callbacks, Deno/Cloudflare-compatible hashing and stream handling, and
ai-proxy routing.

The upstream MIT license is preserved in
`third_party/dsh-cmdgo-provider/LICENSE`.
